title: Don’t Sweat the Small Stuff: Segment-Level Meta-Evaluation Based on Pairwise Difference Correlation

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting artificial noise into all scores of a randomly selected translation system to simulate systematic scoring skew and measuring the meta-evaluation metric's robustness (score degradation).
Injecting random noise into scores associated with specific segments (source texts) to simulate bias based on sentence difficulty or content, and measuring meta-evaluation metric robustness.

Evaluating whether meta-evaluation metrics incorrectly favor "sentinel" metrics that score translations based only on the candidate text (ignoring source and reference) compared to accuracy-focused metrics.

Constructing an "oracle" metric based on Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) gender mismatch error annotations and calculating how well meta-evaluation metrics correlate with human weighting of these gender errors.
